material_definitions: Among the best Li+ ion conducting solid electrolytes so far are Li3xLa(2/3-x)□(1/3-2x)TiO3 defect perovskites.
warnings: Value is an approximate, general value cited from external references [2–5].

material_definitions: Li3xLa(2/3-x)□(4/3-2x)Nb2O6 defect perovskite solid solutions possess considerable vacancy concentration and high density of lithium migration channels.
warnings: Value is the upper bound of the cited approximate range (10^-5 to 10^-4).
Value is cited from external references [6–9].

material_definitions: The materials are Li(0.5-y)Na(y)La(0.5) vacancy Nb2O6 multicomponent oxides, studied across a range of isovalent substitutions (y).
The sintered materials showed a single-phase orthorhombic defect perovskite structure (sp. gr. Pmmm), regardless of the sodium content.
Ionic conductivity is primarily determined by Li+ transport, as Na+ is incapable of participating in ionic transport in these systems.
measurements.source_caption: Conductivity as a function of lithium content for Li(0.5-y) Na(y) La(0.5) vacancy Nb2O6 at (1) 290 and (2) 370 K.
